generation_config.input_convention: pre-command obs7 + previous executed normalized action4

dataset.transition_rule: o_t=inputs[t,:7], a_t=actions[t], next=inputs[t+1,:7]; within episode only
dataset.previous_action_rule: inputs[t,7:11] = executed normalized action at t-1; reset=0

training.architecture:
ResidualTransition(
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=68, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): Tanh()
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (3): Tanh()
    (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=64, bias=True)
  )
)
training.optimizer: Adam defaults lr=.001, betas=.9/.999 eps=1e-8; no gradient clipping
training.order_rule: default_rng(seed=0).permutation(Train complete episodes); all legal K10 windows per episode minibatch
training.backpropagation: All K latent states connected; no detach and no horizon teacher input; E/D outside graph

provenance.frame_rule: all saved observation frames; includes final saved frame of each episode

windows.protocol: all starts t in range(max(0,N-H+1)), per episode

pi_magnitude_bins.rule: Train transition PI norm tertiles; small<q1, q1<=medium<q2, large>=q2

decoder_floor.protocol: D(teacher z[t+H]) vs recorded o[t+H] at exact shared Test starts; offline reconstruction reference, no T
decoder_floor.interpretation: Called Decoder Floor by convention; not a mathematical lower bound or additive decomposition of nonlinear T/D error

1.indexing: encoder z_(t+H-1) used to predict endpoint o_(t+H); H=1 is identical warmed z_t

5.indexing: encoder z_(t+H-1) used to predict endpoint o_(t+H); H=1 is identical warmed z_t

10.indexing: encoder z_(t+H-1) used to predict endpoint o_(t+H); H=1 is identical warmed z_t

25.indexing: encoder z_(t+H-1) used to predict endpoint o_(t+H); H=1 is identical warmed z_t

50.indexing: encoder z_(t+H-1) used to predict endpoint o_(t+H); H=1 is identical warmed z_t

selected_window.rule: first Test episode eligible for max horizon; midpoint legal start, no performance selection

objective: uniform mean over all windows,10steps,64dimensions ((predicted latent-teacher latent)/unchanged Train latent std)^2
protocol: teacher z[t] initial only; fully differentiable T-only residual recursion with recorded actions; no future teacher input; frozen D readout never fed back
limitations: Single seed, nominal simulation, recorded future actions, overlapping windows.
Only K10 latent objective; Encoder/Decoder fixed, no joint or observation loss, no policy/planning.
Teacher latent is a frozen representation, not physical ground truth.
Decoder Floor is an offline teacher readout reference, not a rigorous lower bound; nonlinear errors are not additive.
K10 excludes last9starts per episode used by original K1; therefore comparison is prescribed objective/window-horizon intervention, not perfectly sample-matched.
Checkpoint selection metrics are horizon-specific; short/long accuracy tradeoffs must both be reported.

assessment.conclusion: K10 latent autoregressive training improves H10/H25/H50 propagation and decoded observation prediction, but substantially worsens H1/H5 local latent accuracy. Both transition drift and decoder reconstruction bottlenecks remain.
assessment.common_h50_start_cohort: Same qualitative local-regression/long-horizon-improvement ordering; not explained by differing horizon cohorts.
assessment.decoder_interpretation: Teacher decoder reference near .08 confirms material reconstruction error; K10 H50 decoded RMSE .356 remains far above it. It is not a rigorous lower bound and RMSE errors cannot be subtracted to isolate transition error.
assessment.causal_boundary: Frozen components and identical initialization isolate the prescribed transition-objective intervention, but terminal-tail window support and horizon-specific validation selection also differ. No perfect sample-matched causal effect, independent-trial significance or complete physical state sufficiency claim.
assessment.next_recommendation_only: Retain this frozen baseline; consider a decoder-only reconstruction control before separately authorized joint latent learning. No next experiment executed.
